d:
An extensive collection of Rule 34 content based on the 2005 game Psychonauts and it's sequels/tie-ins. There have been other galleries in the past, but this one is bigger and will be regularly updated as more content is produced. Please enjoy responsibly.

Shota and lolicon appear, so if you're adverse to those things this isn't for you. If you adore those things, you're in the right place. Gallery is Vannila, so no Yaoi/Yuri content.
